source: Indiana State Department of Health, Mortality Report, Table 5: Deaths from 39 Selected Causes by Race and Sex, Indiana Residents by County (all races total)
note: Indiana ISDH Mortality Report Table 5 (deaths from 39 selected causes by county, all races and sexes). THIS FILE: 2003-2017 (2000-2002 editions are in in_mortality_county_2000-2002.json; merge them per cause before the build). Counts of 0-9 are published for every county; no suppression is stated in the Table 5 pages. 2014 Wayne County page is missing on the site (logged). 2018+ editions were not found at this address. Cause rows matched by ICD code string; heart, stroke, diabetes, cancer, Alzheimer's, CLRD, flu, liver, kidney, suicide, homicide follow the same groupings as CDC's 113 list.
query: GET /health/reports/mortality/<year>/table05/tbl05_<NN>.htm, NN = 1..92 alphabetical county number from tbl_05_index.htm
